title: 0050.TW 5-minute realized variance HAR-RV pilot

method.rv_target: sum of squared 5-minute log returns from observed 0050.TW bars
method.total_rv_target: intraday RV plus squared overnight open-vs-previous-close return
method.dm_test: volpred.stats.model_evaluation.dm_test on pointwise QLIKE losses; negative t means first model is better.
method.paper_grade_warning: OOS N must be >= 252; this pilot has far fewer observations.

lookahead_guard: HAR features use target.shift(1), rolling(5).mean().shift(1), and rolling(22).mean().shift(1).
BPV features use bpv.shift(1), rolling(5).mean().shift(1), and rolling(22).mean().shift(1).
For forecast date t, OLS training rows are df.iloc[:pos], strictly earlier than t.

literature.citation: Corsi (2009), Journal of Financial Econometrics, A Simple Approximate Long-Memory Model of Realized Volatility.
literature.role: Canonical HAR-RV model with daily / weekly / monthly realized-volatility components.

literature.citation: Andersen, Bollerslev, Diebold, and Labys (2003), Econometrica, Modeling and Forecasting Realized Volatility.
literature.role: High-frequency intraday returns as realized-volatility measurement framework.

literature.citation: Hansen and Lunde (2005), Journal of Financial Econometrics, A Realized Variance for the Whole Day Based on Intermittent High-Frequency Data.
literature.role: Motivates reporting intraday RV separately from overnight/whole-day RV.

literature.citation: Barndorff-Nielsen and Shephard (2002), JRSS-B, Econometric analysis of realized volatility.
literature.role: Realized-variance / power-variation foundations and BPV-style jump diagnostics.

related_prior_work.note: SPY 5-minute pilot found RV is more autocorrelated than daily r^2, but was preliminary.
SPY pre-HAR-RV validation documented bar-count and proxy-quality checks for 5-minute data.
Backlog requested Taiwan 5-minute HAR-RV for 0050.TW once enough data accumulated.

clean_tw50_data_sanity.note: Expected zero for 2026-only intraday bars; this is a 0050.TW split-artifact guard, not the RV estimator.

notes: The 0050.TW 5-minute data pipeline is usable: 94 days, 53-54 bars/day, no large intraday gaps.
Forecast comparison is intentionally pilot-only because OOS length is below the project 252-day minimum.
Do not write a knowledge entry or article-grade claim from this pilot alone.
